description: Pure-JS wheel, time, date, date-time, select and emoji pickers plus bottom sheets for React Native, Expo and React Native Web.
rules: Install @elik56a/react-native-pickers. It is pure JavaScript with no native code, so it works in Expo Go without a rebuild.
On native, import from feature subpaths such as '@elik56a/react-native-pickers/date' so Metro only bundles the pickers you use.
Components are controlled with value + onChange. onChange fires for user changes only, not when value is set programmatically.
